findings.title: onlyInMode encodes the decision faithfully
findings.detail: The decision's EASY_REESTABLISHMENT onlyWhen 'plan in EASY mode and zones in force' is now explicit in the values and enforced independently of effortOnly. Outside EASY the reason reused is MODE_WALK_JOG_RESTART_RETURN; since the only non-EASY run modes are WALK_JOG, RESTART and RETURN (and no mode is already effort-only), the reason is accurate.

findings.title: Fault isolation is fail-closed
findings.detail: A throw becomes UNAVAILABLE / FIVE_ZONE_ERROR (sessions NONE / FIVE_ZONE_ERROR); no cue can appear from a faulted path and nothing else moves. A partially faulted state (zones AVAILABLE, sessions FIVE_ZONE_ERROR) can occur only with malformed values, which production cannot load (pinned bytes). Engineering should not let the catch hide defects in testing (log or count in development).

noZonesRuling.ruling: The decision's state NO_ZONES (role NONE with the zones' typed reason) governs the roles that depend on zones, i.e. the COMPLEMENTARY_CEILING_CUE families. THRESHOLD, HALF_MARATHON_SPECIFIC, MARATHON_SPECIFIC, FIVE_K_SPECIFIC, TEN_K_SPECIFIC, STRIDES, RACE and RACE_TOUCH keep NO_HEART_RATE_GUIDANCE with their own reason whether or not zones exist; WALK, WALK_JOG and FAMILIAR_REPEATED_BOUTS keep NONE / EFFORT_ONLY_FAMILY. Hold, boundary off and effort-only modes still give NONE for every family first.
noZonesRuling.rationale: Those families' reasons are sporting statements that hold independently of any reference (fixed fractions are not individual thresholds; heart rate lags short hard bouts; race-day guidance stays as approved). In both readings the session carries no heart-rate number and no cue, so requiring NONE for every family would change no guidance; the implemented reading keeps the more informative, always-true reason and keeps the zone-dependent role (the cue) the only one gated by zone availability.
noZonesRuling.condition: A client must take zone availability from the week-level heartRateFiveZones status and reason, never from a per-session NO_HEART_RATE_GUIDANCE reason, and must show no zone bpm for those sessions.
